common_frame: x_p transverse; h=y_p-y_p_base along the measured inclined plume. h=0 is the first supported fitted-axis measurement plane, not physical atomiser surface.
diameter_source_or_assumption: User-selected nominal model estimate: 5 um nominal mesh aperture, emerging jet diameter assumed equal to aperture; Rayleigh d_drop approximately 1.89*d_jet = 9.45 um, rounded to 10 um. Not measured sizing or a validated size distribution.

diameter_model.selection: Use droplet_diameters_um for every calculation; 9.45 um records motivation only. Replace configurable values and provenance when measured sizing is available.
diameter_model.applicability: Classical inviscid cylindrical-jet breakup motivates the estimate; applicability to this driven mesh atomiser and equality of emerging jet and aperture diameters are not validated.

release_definition: Initialise both measured aligned components at the same h=0 plane. Audit original seven transverse grid offsets; omit unsupported PZT or gas samples without extrapolation.
properties_assumptions: Pressure 101325 Pa; water at the recorded air temperature of 20 C; dry-air properties approximate unknown humidity
local_stokes_timescale: D0 / norm(prescribed local mean gas velocity), not a nozzle-exit or forcing-frequency timescale

co_directed.reference_planes: h=0 at first valid saved fitted-axis PZT measurement. Interpolate the first supported developing-branch ZNMF Uc=0.96 m/s station and place it at h=0, with its local centreline on x_p=0. Entire gas field uses one rigid rotation/translation; Xj=x_j0+h.
co_directed.plume_reference: First valid measured point on fixed fitted axis; measurement entrance plane, not documented atomiser surface
co_directed.release_definition: Initialise both measured aligned components at the same h=0 plane. Audit original seven transverse grid offsets; omit unsupported PZT or gas samples without extrapolation.
co_directed.initial_condition_interpretation: One axis reference and supported unweighted transverse sensitivity starts at the measured plume entrance. No whole-plume population weights are inferred.

momentum_audit.RK4_stage_integrals: Integrate drag and effective-gravity acceleration components as passive states using identical RK4 quadrature; multiply by particle mass for impulse. Verify additionally by independent trapezoidal integration of saved forces.

drag_model_documentation.name: Existing Stokes / Schiller-Naumann hybrid, retained for audit
drag_model_documentation.low_Re_approximation: The small finite-Re correction is neglected in the declared Stokes branch; zero slip is handled without division by its magnitude. This is not claimed to be pure Schiller-Naumann below the branch threshold.
